title: Page 8
content_zh:
“是啊，爱你又怎样！很可笑吗？！你这个可恶的混蛋……”她看他那脸不可思议的笑脸，心情就更差了，觉得他现在一定是在嘲笑她的愚蠢和狼狈，居然会爱上他这种无赖恶棍……
“不是可笑，是……我现在好想大笑！”他直接抱住她大笑三声，不知道该用什么话来表达心中的欢悦，原来心里那股不知道她究竟对他是何感觉的惶惑全都不见了，此刻的心情就像烟火被点燃了，瞬间开出一朵朵璀璨闪亮的花火……
啊！太美妙了……
“走开！”她使劲推开他，觉得这男人是不是疯了，她哭成这样他还笑得出来，到底有没有一点点良心啊！
杜天海被这么一推，终于暂时搁下自己的好心情，想到眼前还有一些问题有待解决，首先——
“告诉我，是哪个该死的家伙说我不爱你的！难道你以为我这些日子是因为闲着无聊才会赖在你身边寻你开心，千方百计要留住你也只是因为想和你上床吗？”他抓住她的肩头问道，觉得自己被骂得很冤枉，没料到她怎么会有误差这么大的想法。
他可以让她多揍几下，也不能接受这一项不实的指控。
或许一开始他没有认清自己对她的感觉是何定位，纯粹是出于一份不甘心她被其他男人抢走的妒意而想抓住她。但随着这些日子愈来愈多的牵挂与思念，以及想着她时内心那股充实的快乐，全都让他意识到自己对她的确是存有特别的感情，那是他遗失很久的感觉，更是任何女人都无法给他的心动。
只有这个女人，让他觉得自己的心还活生生的跳动着，还有想要去好好珍惜、相信、爱护一个人的感觉……
那不叫爱又是什么？
佟映晨望着他有些激动的神情，直视那双不像有半点虚伪的黑眸，心中真的对自己的想法产生了刹那的怀疑。其实这段日子里他大幅改变了对待她的方式，也没再听闻他和哪个女人走得太近，下班了就回来赖在家里，总是待在她看得到的地方……这种种的变化也曾让她想过他会不会是真心的，但一看到他胸前的项炼——
她的心又被扯痛了一下，要自己别再傻下去，他心里的人从来就不是她。
“不，你爱的人不是我，而是送你这条项炼的女人，所以你才会一直戴着这条项炼来纪念她不是吗？”她哽咽地戳破他好听的谎言，不怕惹他生气，反正就算再挨他一顿脾气，和他大吵一架，她的心情也不会比现在差到哪里去。
一提起他胸前的颈炼，他的神色先是一怔，随即变得有些灰暗，不过倒是不见发怒的迹象……
“不是，我早就不爱她了。”他沉着脸否认自己的心里还有别人的存在。
“你是！你明明就还忘不掉那个小敏，所以才会在喝醉酒后还想着她、梦到她，一直喊着她的名字叫她不要走，甚至把我当成她……跟我上了床。”为了让他无法再狡辩他心中藏着一个女人的事实，她索性把一切的事情都告诉他，让他知道自己有多么可恶、多么伤人。
一想到他抱着自己想着别的女人的画面，她的心又像被刀划过同一道伤口般的淌血，痛得眼泪直流。
“我……把你当成她……上床？！”他神情错愕加结巴，一点都不记得这是什么时候发生的事，他怎么可能把她当成小敏——
难道！他瞠大双目看着她，猜想着一年多前的那夜……莫非这就是她一夕变脸，突然不理人的原因？
“对，就是你想的那样，所以现在你还敢否认说你不爱她吗？”她看他的表情就知道他都想通了，因此最好不要再——

“我不爱她，我爱的是你！”他一把扯下自己胸前的颈炼，神情坚毅地望着她。
事实上最近他几乎都快忘了这条项炼的存在，只是很习惯的戴在胸口，一直没取下。
这下换她一脸愕然，不懂他怎会扯断自己最重视的项炼？
“小敏曾经是我深爱过的女人，但那已经是过去的事了。我一直戴着这条项炼并不是因为要纪念她，而是为了提醒自己不要再受骗……”为了取信于妻子，他毅然决定道出与小敏之间的过去，这原本是他绝对不愿对人提起的痛苦往事……
小敏是他第一次真心爱上，想要为她付出一切的女人。因为太爱她，他还曾经原谅过她和前男友藕断丝连的暖味行为，在她的苦苦哀求下答应与她重修旧好，甚至在得知她怀孕后，马上着手准备婚事，打算娶她为妻……
结果就在他们订婚后的半个月，他出国出差，她却在另一个国家和她的前男友一起发生交通事故，意外身亡，最后还验出她肚子里的孩子跟车上的两名大人有血缘关系，证实那孩子是她和前男友的亲骨血……
当时杜天海接到这晴天霹雳的消息，一时间都不晓得该难过还是生气，被挚爱背叛的感觉就像有千万根的细针流向心脏般刺痛难当，让他连作梦都会惊醒，从此也对爱情失去了信心，彻底抛弃了让它在他生命中存活的可能。
“我忘不了她，是因为恨，不是爱。”他握紧手中的项炼，这些年来一直把它当成提醒自己的工具，或许也在无形间让它成了自己的枷锁，禁锢了他的心，直到遇见佟映晨，才挣脱了这个束缚，没想到它却也成了伤害她的利器……
“真的？”她听完这个故事，大概因为太震惊了，眼泪都不知不觉地停了下来，心里还不自觉地替他感到有点难过。
“当然是真的，我干么拿这种事开玩笑。”他轻轻地拭去她脸上未干的泪痕，动作温柔得像怕碰碎了她。看她哭得泪眼汪汪，鼻子红通通，他的心都拧成一团了！
这时候就真希望她是个坚强的女强人，而不是个哭到他心酸的小女人。
“可是，不管是爱还是恨，总之你就是抱着我喊着她的名字，把我当成了她。”她望着他柔情关爱的眼神，心里还是介意着他抱着自己、喊着别人。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
再想一想，可能是因为她那阵子让他心烦意乱，产生许多在其他女人身上不曾发生过的情绪，而那感觉又和他爱上小敏时如此类似，所以他才会刚好在那天梦到了小敏，不过他很肯定自己绝对没有搞错上床的对象。
“隔天酒醒了当然知道是我。”她抿着唇喃喃地说。尽管心中已经很没用的信了他大半，但嘴上可不想轻易地顺从他。
讨厌，为什么她的心不如她的嘴巴硬呢？尤其是脑袋还很理智，一听他把事情合理的解释了一遍，她就没办法再装作任性地跟他无理取闹，心情很自然地就趋于平缓，皱着脸也挤不出眼泪来……
有时候她还真讨厌自己的理性与冷静！
杜天海看着她那脸像在呕气又有点懊恼的神情，觉得他老婆真是可爱透了。
“我酒还没醒也知道是你，这脸、这胸部、这腰、这屁股……我一项都不会认错。”他顺势抱住她，朝她身上揩油地摸了一遍。
“不要碰我，谁知道……你认得的女人又何止我一个！”她冷着脸，还是有点生闷气地挥开他不安分的手。

人心就是这样，当认定小敏对他很重要的时候，其他女人她反而还不太放在心上。现在摒除了小敏这个第一顺位，后头的其他女人突然变得很令她介意。
content_en:
"Yeah, so what if I love you! Is it ridiculous?! You hateful bastard..." She felt even worse when she saw the incredible smile on his face. She felt that he must be laughing at her stupidity and embarrassment for actually falling in love with a rogue villain like him...
"It's not ridiculous, it's... I really want to laugh now!" He hugged her and laughed three times. He didn't know what words to use to express the joy in his heart. It turned out that the confusion in his heart about how she felt about him was all gone. His mood at this moment was like a firework being lit, and bright and shining fireworks bloomed in an instant...
Ah! So wonderful…
"Go away!" She pushed him away hard, wondering if this man was crazy. He could still laugh when she cried like this. Did he have any conscience at all?
Being pushed like this, Du Tianhai finally put aside his good mood temporarily, thinking that there were still some problems to be solved before him, first of all——
"Tell me, who is the damn guy who said I don't love you! Do you think I stay by your side these days because I am idle and bored, and I try every means to keep you just because I want to sleep with you?" He grabbed her shoulder and asked, feeling that he was being scolded very unjustly, and he didn't expect her to have such a big error in thinking.
He could give her a few more beatings, but he couldn't accept this false accusation.
Perhaps he didn't recognize the position of his feelings for her at first, and wanted to capture her purely out of jealousy that he was unwilling to let her be snatched away by other men. But with the increasing care and longing these days, as well as the fulfilling happiness in his heart when thinking about her, he realized that he did have special feelings for her. It was a feeling that he had lost for a long time, and it was a feeling that no woman could give him.
Only this woman made him feel that his heart was still beating alive, and that he wanted to cherish, believe, and love someone...
What is that if it's not love?
Tong Yingchen looked at his somewhat excited expression and looked directly into those black eyes that didn't seem to be hypocritical at all, and she really doubted her own thoughts for a moment. In fact, he had greatly changed the way he treated her during these days, and she no longer heard of any woman he was getting too close to. He would come back home after get off work, always staying where she could see her... These changes had made her wonder if he was sincere, but when she saw the necklace on his chest -
Her heart felt painful again, and she wanted to stop being stupid. The person in his heart was never her.
"No, the person you love is not me, but the woman who gave you this necklace, so you will always wear this necklace to commemorate her, right?" She choked up and exposed his nice lie, not afraid of making him angry. Anyway, even if she got angry with him again and had a big quarrel with him, her mood would not be any worse than now.
When he mentioned the necklace on his chest, his expression was startled at first, and then turned a little gray, but there was no sign of anger...
"No, I stopped loving her a long time ago." He denied with a stern face that there was someone else in his heart.
"You are! You obviously can't forget that Xiao Min, so you still think about her and dream about her when you are drunk, keep calling her name to tell her not to leave, and even think of me as her... and sleep with me." In order to prevent him from being able to quibble about the fact that there is a woman hidden in his heart, she simply told him everything, letting him know how hateful and hurtful she was.
When she thought of the image of him holding her and thinking about other women, her heart bleeds like the same wound cut by a knife, and she shed tears in pain.
"I... thought you were her... to go to bed with?!" He looked stunned and stuttered, not remembering when this happened. How could he think she was Xiao Min——
Could it be! He looked at her with wide eyes, guessing what happened more than a year ago.Night... Could this be the reason why she suddenly changed her face and ignored people?
"Yes, that's what you think, so now do you still dare to deny that you don't love her?" She knew from his expression that he had figured it all out, so it was best not to--
"I don't love her, I love you!" He pulled off the necklace on his chest and looked at her resolutely.
In fact, he had almost forgotten the existence of this necklace recently. He just wore it on his chest very habitually and never took it off.
Now she looked stunned. She didn't understand how he could tear off the necklace she valued most.
"Xiao Min was once a woman I loved deeply, but that is already in the past. I have been wearing this necklace not because I want to commemorate her, but to remind myself not to be deceived again..." In order to win his wife's trust, he resolutely decided to reveal the past between him and Xiao Min. This was originally a painful past that he absolutely did not want to mention to others...
Xiao Min was the first woman he truly fell in love with and wanted to give everything to her. Because he loved her so much, he even forgave her for her estranged relationship with her ex-boyfriend, and agreed to rebuild their old relationship with her under her pleading. Even after learning that she was pregnant, he immediately started to prepare for the marriage and planned to marry her...
As a result, just half a month after their engagement, he went abroad for a business trip, but she was involved in a traffic accident with her ex-boyfriend in another country and died unexpectedly. Finally, it was found that the child in her belly was related to the two adults in the car, confirming that the child was the biological blood of her and her ex-boyfriend...
When Du Tianhai received this shocking news, he didn't know whether to be sad or angry for a moment. The feeling of being betrayed by his beloved was like thousands of fine needles flowing to his heart, which stung so hard that he would wake up even from his dreams. From then on, he lost confidence in love and completely gave up the possibility of letting it survive in his life.
"I can't forget her because of hatred, not love." He held the necklace in his hand tightly. He had used it as a tool to remind himself over the years. Perhaps he had also unknowingly let it become his shackles, imprisoning his heart. It was not until he met Tong Yingchen that he broke free from this shackles. Unexpectedly, it also became a weapon to hurt her...
"Really?" After hearing this story, she probably stopped crying because she was so shocked, and she unconsciously felt a little sad for him.
"Of course it's true. Why would I joke about something like this?" He gently wiped away the wet tears on her face, his movements gentle as if he was afraid of breaking her. Seeing her crying with tears in her eyes and her nose red, his heart twisted into a ball!
At this time, he really hoped that she was a strong woman and not a little woman who cried until he felt sad.
"But, whether it's love or hate, in short, you just hugged me and called her name, thinking that I was her." She looked at his tender and caring eyes, but she still cared about him hugging her and calling others.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Thinking about it again, it might be because she made him upset at that time and produced many emotions that had never happened to other women, and the feeling was so similar to when he fell in love with Xiao Min, so he happened to dream about Xiao Min that day, but he was very sure that he was definitely not wrong about the person he slept with.
"Of course you'll know it's me when you wake up the next day." She pursed her lips and murmured. Although I already trusted him in my heart, I didn't want to obey him easily.
Disgusting, why is her heart not as hard as her mouth? Especially since her head was still very rational. Once she heard him explain things rationally, she could no longer pretend to be willful and make trouble with him unreasonably. Her mood naturally calmed down, and she couldn't squeeze out tears even with her face wrinkled...
Sometimes she really hates her rationality and calmness!
Du Tianhai looked at her face that looked like she was vomiting and a little annoyed, and felt that his wife was really cute.
"Even before I sobered up, I knew it was you. This face, these breasts, this waist, this ass... I couldn't admit any of it. "He hugged her and touched her body.
"Don't touch me, who knows... I'm not the only woman you recognize! "She waved away his restless hand with a cold face, still a little sulky.
People's hearts are like this. When Xiao Min is determined to be very important to him, she doesn't care much about other women. Now that Xiao Min was eliminated as the first choice, the other women behind her suddenly became very interesting to her.
